title: Mandatory and suspensory merger notification regime
summary: A new ACCC administrative merger control regime allowed voluntary notification from 1 July 2025 and made notification of acquisitions above thresholds mandatory and suspensory from 1 January 2026, replacing the voluntary informal clearance and merger authorisation system.

instruments.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Mergers and Acquisitions Reform) Act 2024

commenced.what: Schedule 1 Part 2 (voluntary notification under new system)
Schedule 1 Part 3 and Schedule 2 Part 1 (mandatory, suspensory regime)

direction_rationale: Mandatory review of acquisitions above thresholds (including serial acquisitions) should block more anti-competitive mergers, though filing costs and delays may deter some pro-competitive deals.
